# Search code hosting issues and pull requests
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Search the open issues and pull requests or merge requests for the selected workspace repository.

## Search a list

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/code_hosting.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/code_hosting_search.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/code_hosting.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/CodeHostingPanel.vue -->

Select **Code hosting** in the sidebar. Expand **Issues** or **Pull requests** (GitHub) or **Merge requests** (GitLab), then enter a search in that list's search field. The results are open items; select a row to open its details.

## Save a search

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/code_hosting_saved_searches.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/stores/code_hosting_searches.ts -->

Run a search and choose **Save this search**. Give the search a name, choose whether it is for **User** or **Workspace**, then select **Save**. The saved search appears at the chosen level; select it later to reuse the search.

## Refresh results

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/code_hosting.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/CodeHostingPanel.vue -->

Choose **Refresh** to request current lists from GitHub or GitLab. If a refresh fails, Heidrun Code may show previously available results with a failure message.
